constitution.label: Constitution of the Republic of Armenia
constitution.note: 9 chapters, 117 articles. Adopted 5 July 1995, amended 2005 and 2015.

numbering.act_citation_note: HO = Հ.Օ. (Հայաuтан Orenlq, RA Law). Sequential within year. Number resets each year.
numbering.article_numbering_note: Articles numbered continuously throughout entire act; do not restart per Chapter
numbering.insertion_style_note: Inserted articles may use Article 5¹ or Article 5.1 notation.

enacting_formulae.text:
LAW OF THE REPUBLIC OF ARMENIA
[Title]
Adopted by the National Assembly of the Republic of Armenia on [date]
enacting_formulae.note: No Anglophone-style 'Be it enacted' formula. The adoption attribution in the preface header is the functional equivalent. In Armenian: Ընдunнвад э Хайаstaни Ханрапетутян Азгаын Жогови когмits [ամuathiw]-ин.

amendments.phrasing: Article N of Law HO-{N}-N shall be supplemented by a new part with the following content: ... / Part N of Article N shall be amended as follows: ... / Article N shall be declared void.

amendments.repeal_phrasing: shall be declared void (ուժ կortsratskh ճanaсhel)

structuring.prompt_additions: Use ARTICLE as the basic unit (not SECTION). Hierarchy is CHAPTER > ARTICLE > PARAGRAPH > POINT. Articles are numbered continuously throughout the entire act — they do not restart per chapter. Parts within articles (Armenian: մաس, 'mas') map to PARAGRAPH. Points within parts (Armenian: կetq) map to POINT. There is no SUBSECTION level in Armenian legislation. The document heading block ('LAW OF THE REPUBLIC OF ARMENIA / [Title] / Adopted by the National Assembly on [date]') maps to PREFACE, not PREAMBLE. Only include PREAMBLE if the act has substantive recitals. The President's signature block at the end maps to CONCLUSIONS.

supranational_memberships.direct_effect_note: EAEU Regulations have direct effect per EAEU Court ruling of April 2017. EAEU Customs Code directly applicable. Domestic law in customs, technical regulations, and sanitary/phytosanitary standards may be superseded.
ECHR judgments are binding on Armenia. Convention rights must be applied by domestic courts. Requires no transposition but has constitutional-level effect.
UN Security Council Chapter VII resolutions are binding. General Assembly resolutions are non-binding.

display.script_note: Armenian script (Հayeren). Unicode block: U+0531–U+058F (Armenian), U+FB13–U+FB17 (Armenian ligatures). Left-to-right. Not Latin, not Cyrillic.
